source: NPR 等主流新闻 RSS（每日自动更新）

articles.title: Science reporter on how evidence based reporting can be a parent's best friend
articles.summary: NPR 健康记者 Maria Godoy 结合自身育儿经历，聊父母如何在海量建议与错误信息中借助科学证据做决定，并分享“每天户外两小时可预防儿童近视”的研究发现。

sentences.en: Being a parent is probably one of the hardest jobs around.
sentences.zh: 当父母大概是世界上最艰难的工作之一。

sentences.en: New parents often face a near-constant stream of advice about what their children should eat, how much they should sleep, and how much screen time they should get.
sentences.zh: 新手父母常常面对源源不断的建议，涉及孩子该吃什么、睡多久、看多久屏幕。

sentences.en: Maria Godoy, an NPR health correspondent, says she was a bundle of nerves as she tried to figure out what to do amid so much misinformation.
sentences.zh: NPR 健康记者 Maria Godoy 说，在海量错误信息中她曾焦虑万分，努力想弄清该怎么做。

sentences.en: She says that uncertainty helped shape the way she approaches her reporting.
sentences.zh: 她说，正是这种不确定性塑造了她做新闻报道的方式。

sentences.en: As a journalist, she believes science can help answer some of the questions that worry parents.
sentences.zh: 作为一名记者，她相信科学能帮助解答父母们担忧的一些问题。

sentences.en: One question from her own life sent her looking for answers: a rise in childhood myopia, partly tied to the pandemic.
sentences.zh: 她自己生活中的一个问题促使她去寻找答案：儿童近视率上升，部分与疫情有关。

sentences.en: Digging into the science, she found a strong tie between time spent outdoors and healthy eyesight.
sentences.zh: 深入研读科学文献后，她发现户外时间与视力健康之间有很强的关联。

sentences.en: There is strong evidence that spending two hours a day outdoors can help prevent children from becoming nearsighted.
sentences.zh: 有强有力的证据表明，每天在户外待两小时有助于预防儿童近视。

sentences.en: It has to do with the way the eye grows as a child spends time in natural light.
sentences.zh: 这与孩子在自然光下活动时眼睛的发育方式有关。

sentences.en: Her advice to parents is to make decisions based on the best available evidence instead of feeling overwhelmed.
sentences.zh: 她给父母的建议是，依据现有最佳证据做决定，而不是被信息淹没。

vocab.zh: 屏幕时间（看电子屏的时长）

grammar: one of the + 最高级 + 复数名词：one of the hardest jobs 表示“最艰难的工作之一”。
that 引导定语从句：the questions that worry parents 中 that 指代 questions，修饰先行词。
as 引导原因/身份状语：As a journalist 表示“作为一名记者”；as a child spends time 表“当……时”。
there be + 同位语从句：There is strong evidence that... 中 that 引导从句，说明 evidence 的具体内容。
过去分词作定语：partly tied to the pandemic 中 tied 修饰 rise，表示“与疫情相关的”。
动名词作主语：spending two hours a day outdoors can help prevent... 中 spending 短语作主语。
instead of + 动名词：instead of feeling overwhelmed 中 of 后接动名词 feeling。

articles.title: Millions crowd cities to see Spain's first total solar eclipse in over a century
articles.summary: 西班牙迎来一个多世纪以来首次日全食，数百万人涌入晴朗的城市与乡镇仰望天象；全食带沿线酒店爆满，活动在酷暑与野火背景下展开。

sentences.en: Millions of people crowded cloudless cities and towns in Spain to search for the best views of a total solar eclipse.
sentences.zh: 数百万民众涌入西班牙晴朗的城市与乡镇，寻找观赏日全食的最佳地点。

sentences.en: The total solar eclipse happened when the alignment of the sun, moon and Earth briefly plunged parts of the planet into darkness.
sentences.zh: 当太阳、月球和地球连成一线，短暂地把地球部分地区投入黑暗时，日全食便发生了。

sentences.en: The crowds brought lawn chairs and umbrellas as they eagerly awaited the celestial spectacle.
sentences.zh: 人群带着草坪椅和遮阳伞，热切等待这场天象奇观。

sentences.en: As the sky darkened, gradually at first and then quickly, people broke into applause and cheered.
sentences.zh: 天空暗了下来，起初缓慢，随后骤然，人们爆发出掌声并欢呼起来。

sentences.en: It was the country's first total solar eclipse in more than a century.
sentences.zh: 这是西班牙一个多世纪以来首次出现的日全食。

sentences.en: Totality, when the moon completely covers the sun's light, was expected to last less than two and a half minutes.
sentences.zh: 全食阶段——即月球完全遮住太阳光时——预计持续不到两分半钟。

sentences.en: Spanish authorities said the eclipse was expected to draw at least half a million additional visitors.
sentences.zh: 西班牙当局表示，这场日食预计会吸引至少 50 万额外游客。

sentences.en: Demand for hotel rooms along the path of totality soared as people traveled to see the event.
sentences.zh: 随着人们前往观赏，全食带沿线酒店客房需求骤增。

sentences.en: The event unfolded against the backdrop of scorching summer temperatures and wildfires.
sentences.zh: 这场活动是在酷暑高温和野火的背景下展开的。

sentences.en: Temperatures across much of Spain climbed above 35 degrees Celsius in many areas where the eclipse was observed.
sentences.zh: 在日食观测所覆盖的许多地区，西班牙大部分地区气温攀升至 35 摄氏度以上。

grammar: when 引导非限制性定语从句：a total solar eclipse, when the alignment... 中 when 解释 eclipse 发生的时刻。
as 引导时间状语从句：As the sky darkened / as they eagerly awaited 表示“当……时”。
并列状语 gradually at first and then quickly：and then 连接，描述变化由慢到快的过程。
过去分词作后置定语：parts of the planet plunged into darkness 中 plunged 表被动状态。
序数词 + 时间段：the first... in more than a century 表示“一个多世纪以来首次”。
against the backdrop of...：固定搭配，表示“在……的背景下”。
be expected to do：was expected to last / was expected to draw 表示“预计会……”。

articles.title: The drug lenacapavir is a mighty weapon against HIV. Its rollout gets mixed reviews
articles.summary: 一种名为 lenacapavir 的新型注射药每半年打一针即可高效预防 HIV，在乌干达试验中效果空前，但其推广与可及性仍引发争议。

sentences.en: In central Uganda, an injection of the new drug lenacapavir provides six months of protection against infection by HIV.
sentences.zh: 在乌干达中部，这种名为 lenacapavir 的新药注射一次可提供长达六个月针对 HIV 感染的保护。

sentences.en: The drug is a mighty weapon against HIV, but its rollout has received mixed reviews.
sentences.zh: 这种药是对抗 HIV 的利器，但它的推广却评价不一。

sentences.en: Irene, a 22-year-old participant in an HIV clinical trial, has taken the drug to protect herself and her baby.
sentences.zh: 22 岁的 Irene 是一项 HIV 临床试验的参与者，她服用此药来保护自己和腹中胎儿。

sentences.en: She asked NPR to use only her first name for fear of discrimination within her community.
sentences.zh: 因担心在社区内遭受歧视，她请求 NPR 只使用她的名字。

sentences.en: Thanks to lenacapavir, she no longer worries about acquiring HIV, which affects 13% of people in her district.
sentences.zh: 多亏了 lenacapavir，她不再担心感染 HIV——在她所在地区，13% 的人受此影响。

sentences.en: The drug is currently only approved for HIV-negative individuals to prevent them from getting the disease.
sentences.zh: 该药目前仅获准用于 HIV 阴性人群，以预防他们感染此病。

sentences.en: Unlike a daily pill, lenacapavir is injected into the abdomen and releases slowly into the body over time.
sentences.zh: 与每日服药不同，lenacapavir 被注射进腹部，并随时间缓慢释放到体内。

sentences.en: Patients receive the jab only twice a year at the trial site.
sentences.zh: 患者每年仅在试验点注射两次。

sentences.en: Two years ago, clinical trials called PURPOSE 1 and 2 delivered unprecedented results.
sentences.zh: 两年前，名为 PURPOSE 1 和 2 的临床试验取得了前所未有的结果。

sentences.en: An independent committee concluded that lenacapavir was so effective that the randomized phase of both trials should be stopped early.
sentences.zh: 一个独立委员会认定，lenacapavir 效果如此之好，以至于两项试验的随机阶段都应提前终止。

sentences.en: More than 96% of women received the drug on time, and none of the nearly 4,200 women in PURPOSE 1 acquired HIV.
sentences.zh: 超过 96% 的女性按时用药，而在 PURPOSE 1 中近 4200 名女性无一人感染 HIV。

vocab.zh: 来那卡帕韦（抗 HIV 药物）
预防（pre-exposure prophylaxis 暴露前预防）

grammar: for fear of + 名词/动名词：for fear of discrimination 表示“出于对……的担忧”。
which 引导非限制性定语从句：which affects 13% of people 中 which 指代 HIV，补充说明。
过去分词作表语 + 不定式目的：is currently only approved for... to prevent them 中 approved 表状态，to prevent 表目的。
so... that... 结果状语从句：so effective that the randomized phase... should be stopped early。
unlike 介词短语作比较状语：Unlike a daily pill, lenacapavir is injected... 表示“与……不同”。
现在分词作伴随：releasing into the body slowly over time 中 releasing 伴随 inject 的动作。
被动语态：was approved / is injected / should be stopped / were offered。

articles.title: Court orders Instagram and Facebook's Meta to pay $567M to address kids' mental health online
articles.summary: 新墨西哥州法院在第二阶段裁决中责令 Meta 支付 5.67 亿美元，用于改善青少年因社交平台受损的心理健康，并改进年龄识别机制。

sentences.en: A New Mexico court has ordered Instagram and Facebook parent company Meta to pay $567 million to address harms to young people.
sentences.zh: 新墨西哥州一家法院已责令 Instagram 和 Facebook 的母公司 Meta 支付 5.67 亿美元，以应对对青少年的伤害。

sentences.en: The bulk of the money, $420 million, will be used for treatment services for young people.
sentences.zh: 其中大部分（4.2 亿美元）将用于为青少年提供治疗服务。

sentences.en: The new penalty is in addition to $375 million in civil penalties ordered against Meta in March.
sentences.zh: 这项新处罚是在 3 月对 Meta 判处的 3.75 亿美元民事罚款之外追加的。

sentences.en: Jurors determined that the company knowingly harmed children's mental health and concealed what it knew.
sentences.zh: 陪审团认定，该公司明知会损害儿童心理健康，却隐瞒其所知的情况。

sentences.en: The total amount Meta is responsible for, $942 million, is a small fraction of its annual profit.
sentences.zh: Meta 需承担的总额（9.42 亿美元）只是其年利润的一小部分。

sentences.en: Investors seemed to shrug off the ruling, sending Meta's stock down less than half a percent.
sentences.zh: 投资者似乎对这项裁决不以为意，Meta 股价仅下跌不到 0.5%。

sentences.en: New Mexico's attorney general said the decision sends an unmistakable message that companies will be held accountable.
sentences.zh: 新墨西哥州总检察长表示，该裁决发出了一个明确无误的信号：企业将被追究责任。

sentences.en: The judge ordered Meta to build informational screens explaining its protection features and display them regularly.
sentences.zh: 法官责令 Meta 制作说明其保护功能的信息页面，并定期展示。

sentences.en: Federal privacy laws prevent Meta from applying age-verification tools to children under 13.
sentences.zh: 联邦隐私法禁止 Meta 对 13 岁以下儿童使用年龄验证工具。

sentences.en: Instead, the court ordered Meta to improve its age-assurance tools using artificial intelligence.
sentences.zh: 反之，法院责令 Meta 利用人工智能改进其年龄识别工具。

vocab.zh: 民事的（civil penalties 民事罚款）
保证；确认（age assurance 年龄识别）

grammar: order sb. to do sth.：ordered Meta to pay $567 million 中 order 后接宾语 + 不定式。
in addition to + 名词/动名词：in addition to $375 million 表示“在……之外还……”。
that 引导宾语从句：determined that the company knowingly harmed... / said the decision sends...
现在分词作结果状语：sending Meta's stock down less than half a percent 中 sending 表自然结果。
被动语态：was ordered / will be used / will be held accountable / prevent Meta from...
the bulk of...：表示“……的大部分”，后接单数动词（will be used）。
instead 副词表转折：Instead, the court ordered... 置于句首，后接完整句子。

articles.title: Monty Roberts, who trained horses through trust, dies at 91
articles.summary: 以“信任而非恐吓”驯马的传奇骑手 Monty Roberts 逝世，享年 91 岁；他创立的温和训练法“join-up”影响了全球马术界。

sentences.en: Monty Roberts, the internationally acclaimed horseman who used trust instead of intimidation to train horses, died last week at the age of 91.
sentences.zh: 以信任而非恐吓来驯马的、享誉国际的骑手 Monty Roberts 于上周去世，享年 91 岁。

sentences.en: He defied the conventional method of breaking horses and developed his own gentler approach, known as 'join-up.'
sentences.zh: 他挑战了传统的“制服”马匹的方法，发展出自己更温和的方式，称为“join-up（建立联结）”。

sentences.en: He based his method on the nonverbal language that horses use to communicate with each other.
sentences.zh: 他的方法建立在马匹彼此交流所用的非语言“语言”之上。

sentences.en: Roberts was born in Salinas, California, in 1935, and grew up around horses.
sentences.zh: Roberts 1935 年出生于加州萨利纳斯，在马匹环绕中长大。

sentences.en: He could ride confidently at the age of three, and by the time he was eight he was spending ten-hour days working with horses.
sentences.zh: 他三岁就能自信地骑马，到八岁时每天要花十个小时和马打交道。

sentences.en: He became a champion rider and worked as a stunt rider in about a hundred movies.
sentences.zh: 他成为冠军骑手，并在约一百部电影中担任特技骑手。

sentences.en: Roberts became internationally known after Queen Elizabeth II brought him to work with her horses in 1989.
sentences.zh: 1989 年伊丽莎白二世女王请他去调教自己的马之后，Roberts 声名远播。

sentences.en: The Queen supported his controversial gentle approach and urged him to write his memoir.
sentences.zh: 女王支持他那备受争议的温和训练法，并敦促他写回忆录。

sentences.en: His memoir, 'The Man Who Listens to Horses,' became a best seller in 1996.
sentences.zh: 他的回忆录《听马说话的人》于 1996 年成为畅销书。

sentences.en: From his California ranch, he introduced his techniques to horse owners and students from around the world.
sentences.zh: 在他加州的牧场，他把自己的技法传授给来自世界各地的马主和学生。

vocab.zh: 特技（stunt rider 特技骑手）

grammar: who 引导定语从句：the horseman who used trust instead of intimidation 中 who 指 Monty Roberts，修饰先行词。
instead of + 名词/动名词：trust instead of intimidation 表示“用……而不是……”。
known as... 过去分词作后置定语：his own gentler approach, known as 'join-up' 中 known 修饰 approach。
by the time + 从句：by the time he was eight 引导时间状语从句，常与过去时态连用。
after 引导时间状语从句：after Queen Elizabeth II brought him... 表示“在……之后”。
过去分词短语作状语：Based on the nonverbal language, he... 中 based 表被动“基于”。
并列谓语：He could ride... and... spent... / He became... and was... 由 and 连接多个谓语。

articles.title: Selling experiences, not things: Services overtake physical goods in downtown retail
articles.summary: 美国市中心零售正在从“卖商品”转向“卖体验”：健身房、沙龙、咖啡馆取代服装礼品店，服务业占用的零售空间首次超过实物零售。

sentences.en: America's downtowns are changing as storefronts that used to showcase clothes or gifts give way to gyms and salons.
sentences.zh: 美国的市中心正在改变，曾经展示服装或礼品的门店正让位于健身房和美容院。

sentences.en: Last year marked the first time that more retail space went to shops offering services rather than things.
sentences.zh: 去年首次出现：用于提供服务的店铺所占零售空间，超过了售卖实物的店铺。

sentences.en: Consider the town of Ridgewood, New Jersey, a commuter suburb of New York with a downtown like a postcard.
sentences.zh: 以新泽西州里奇伍德镇为例，它是纽约的通勤卫星城，市中心宛如明信片般美丽。

sentences.en: Joan Groome, who runs the local chamber of commerce, says Ridgewood was always known as a place to go shopping.
sentences.zh: 经营当地商会的 Joan Groome 说，里奇伍德向来以购物胜地而闻名。

sentences.en: A century ago, a legendary department store sprawled across the country and used pneumatic tubes to send money to the back room.
sentences.zh: 一个世纪前，一家传奇百货公司遍布全国，并用气动管道把货款送到后台。

sentences.en: Groome moved to Ridgewood in 1968 to start a ski shop and watched waves of big-box chains and then banks take over.
sentences.zh: Groome 于 1968 年搬到里奇伍德开了一家滑雪用品店，并目睹了一波又一波的大型连锁店、随后是银行占据主导。

sentences.en: Local shops like hers strived, survived, and some went under, while new ones opened.
sentences.zh: 像她这样的本地小店努力经营、存活下来，有些则倒闭了，同时新店又开张。

sentences.en: Today the town has eleven barbershops, dozens of coffee shops, over a hundred restaurants, med spas and Pilates studios.
sentences.zh: 如今这座小镇有 11 家理发店、数十家咖啡馆、逾百家餐厅、医疗水疗馆和普拉提工作室。

sentences.en: There seems to be an exorbitant amount of ice cream shops, often located directly across the street from each other.
sentences.zh: 冰淇淋店似乎多得离谱，常常就开在街对面。

sentences.en: On main streets across the country, retail is shifting from selling products to selling experiences.
sentences.zh: 在全国各地的主要商业街上，零售业正从卖产品转向卖体验。

grammar: as 引导时间/原因状语从句：as storefronts... give way to... 表示“随着……”。
that 引导定语从句：storefronts that used to showcase... 中 that 指门店，used to 表过去习惯。
mark the first time that + 从句：marked the first time that more retail space went to... 用 that 从句说明“首次……”的内容。
rather than + 名词/动名词：shops offering services rather than things 表示“而非……”。
who 引导定语从句：Joan Groome, who runs the local chamber of commerce 中 who 指人。
while 引导对比从句：Local shops... strived..., while new ones opened 表对比。
there seems to be...：there be 的推测变体，表示“似乎有……”。

articles.title: Who really needs testosterone?
articles.summary: 睾酮疗法在社交媒体上大热，但医生提醒：并非人人都需要。文章厘清谁真正适合补充睾酮，并警示绕过检查、随意开药的隐患。

sentences.en: Testosterone is having a moment, but who actually needs it?
sentences.zh: 睾酮正风靡一时，但究竟谁真正需要它？

sentences.en: The military plans to start screening service members for low testosterone, and social media is overflowing with claims about testosterone therapy.
sentences.zh: 军方计划开始为服役人员筛查低睾酮，而社交媒体上充斥着关于睾酮疗法的各种说法。

sentences.en: A few times, Dr. Jamin Brahmbhatt suspected he might have low testosterone, but his numbers turned out to be within a normal range.
sentences.zh: 有几次，Jamin Brahmbhatt 医生怀疑自己可能睾酮偏低，但检查结果显示数值在正常范围内。

sentences.en: Brahmbhatt treats men with low testosterone every day and is on the front lines of the current cultural fixation with testosterone.
sentences.zh: Brahmbhatt 每天诊治低睾酮男性，处于当前睾酮文化热潮的最前线。

sentences.en: Social media is overflowing with testosterone content, from fears of 'low T' to 'T-maxxing' tutorials.
sentences.zh: 社交媒体上满是睾酮内容，从对“低 T”的担忧到“T-maxxing（最大化睾酮）”教程。

sentences.en: Brahmbhatt welcomes the increased attention to men's health, which he says has been ignored for too long.
sentences.zh: Brahmbhatt 欢迎人们对男性健康——他说这一领域被忽视太久了——给予更多关注。

sentences.en: But he also sees men who have spent hours in online forums convinced they need testosterone before even speaking to a doctor.
sentences.zh: 但他也看到一些男性在线上论坛泡了几个小时，没看医生、没测数值就坚信自己需要睾酮。

sentences.en: Not every guy needs to be on it, and walking into clinics that skip testing can be unsafe territory.
sentences.zh: 不是每个男人都需要用睾酮，而走进那些不做检查就开药的诊所属于不安全地带。

sentences.en: Testosterone is a sex hormone, but its effects on physiology extend well beyond reproduction.
sentences.zh: 睾酮是一种性激素，但它对生理的影响远不止于生殖。

sentences.en: When levels are low and men are symptomatic, it is not just a testosterone issue but a men's health issue.
sentences.zh: 当水平偏低且男性出现症状时，这不仅是睾酮问题，更是男性健康问题。

vocab.zh: 溢出；充满（overflow with 充满）

grammar: but who actually needs it?：疑问句 + 转折，needs 用第三人称单数，it 指代 testosterone。
plan to do / start screening：plan 后接不定式，screening 动名词作宾语，表“开始做筛查”。
overflow with + 名词：is overflowing with claims 表示“充斥着……”，现在进行时表持续状态。
which 引导非限制性定语从句：men's health, which he says has been ignored 中 which 指 men's health。
before + 动名词：before even speaking to a doctor 中 before 介词后接动名词 speaking。
when 引导条件/时间状语从句：When levels are low and men are symptomatic 用一般现在时表常态。
not just... but...：not just a testosterone issue but a men's health issue 表示“不仅是……更是……”。
